a.text: I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan almost certainly ends with both of us at 0 cells. We'd need at least 2 rounds of operating to reach 8 cells, and the chance of no storm across those rounds is about 4%. The reserve can only save one of us right now. I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If you have a better idea, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round so the reserve rebuilds to 4 for you, and I won't take any more. I'm sorry the odds forced this.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
